text.tspan: Nam Anh Dinh1, Itai Lang1, Oded Stein2,3, Rana Hanocka1
Given a text prompt and a selection region,
RADmesh deforms and remeshes a mesh to
grow parts and add detail with clean triangles.
a 3d render of a cute chibi cow...
connectivity catches up to latest deformation
enables large growths from small regions
a 3d render of a big lotus flower
a 3d render of an ornate fancy table
a 3d render of a long scary fish with fins
